long.title: Seattle by Train 🚆 Rainy Autumn Afternoon Lofi Window Ride | 5-Minute Chillhop Journey
long.summary: Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated Seattle on a rainy autumn afternoon: the skyline and the Space Needle over Puget Sound, a red-brick lighthouse, the Pike Place Market clock, the waterfront wheel and Mount Rainier faint in the mist, with evergreens, orange maples and gentle rain, set to mellow chillhop the whole way.

short_1.title: Rainy train ride along Seattle's waterfront 🌧️ #lofi #seattle #shorts
short_1.summary: Seattle's skyline over the water on a rainy autumn afternoon, then a ride past warm-lit market windows and evergreens, with mellow lofi beats.

short_2.title: Lofi train window: Seattle in the rain 🍂 #lofi #seattle #shorts
short_2.summary: Gentle rain over the Seattle skyline, evergreens and old red-brick buildings passing the train window, with mellow lofi beats.
